title: Regression Gatekeeper for cost-driven batching/caching config applies and automated rollbacks
creator: Eliot Chen
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight 'Gatekeeper' service that validates batching/caching configuration recommendations before they are applied automatically to production pools and drives automated rollback when quality regressions are detected. This ticket covers spec, acceptance thresholds, integration points with the Optimize recommender, Redwood Console, and runbook for emergency/manual rollback.

Motivation: Our autobatching and cache recommendations reduce per-token cost but have caused subtle quality regressions in a few incidents. We want an automated validation layer that reduces manual review overhead while keeping regression risk bounded. The Gatekeeper should enforce evaluation against canary traffic and golden prompt suites, compute statistical pass/fail, and either allow an automated apply or trigger a rollback/fallthrough policy.

Non-goal: This ticket does not implement new model-level eval metrics (research) or redesign the Optimize recommender algorithms; it focuses on the gate/acceptance and orchestration logic plus integration tests and observability.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper service accepts a proposed config change (batch size, prefix cache TTL, KV-cache enablement, quantization profile) and runs it against a designated canary pool for N minutes.
Gatekeeper runs the golden prompt eval suite and computes pass rates for configured metrics (exact-match, BLEU-ish similarity proxy, response length distribution, perplexity proxy).
For each metric, Gatekeeper applies statistical tests (e.g., bootstrap CI) and uses pre-configured thresholds to decide allow/fail; thresholds are configurable per-customer and per-model.

If a change fails, Gatekeeper prevents automated apply and creates an incident ticket and dashboard snapshot; if it passes but later shows regression in the first 60 minutes on production, automated rollback is triggered.
Console UI shows Gatekeeper decisions (pass/fail), per-metric deltas, and links to raw eval outputs and relevant PRs.
End-to-end integration tests cover happy path (pass => apply), fail => block, and detection => rollback on simulated regression traffic.
implementation_notes: Expose Gatekeeper as a REST endpoint behind Optimize; Optimize calls it with candidate config + sample canary rule and golden prompt set.
Evaluation harness will reuse existing golden prompt assets stored in s3://redwood-evals/goldens/{model}/{suite}.jsonl; Gatekeeper only orchestrates runs via eval-worker queue.

Metrics to compute: answer similarity (embedding cosine + threshold), token distribution shift (KL proxy), hallucination indicators (presence of hallucination tokens via heuristic), request latency and 95th pct latency impact.
Use bootstrap-based confidence intervals to decide significance rather than p-value only; default alpha configurable (default 0.05).
Config change lifecycle: proposed -> canary-apply -> evaluation-window -> approve/apply -> monitor-early -> rollback-if-fail. All transitions are auditable with timestamps in audit log.
milestones: Spec and acceptance criteria reviewed by PM/Design/IR: 2025-03-03
Minimal Gatekeeper prototype (canary orchestration + eval runner): 2025-03-12
Staged rollout to non-critical pools (10% traffic): 2025-03-22
risks: False negatives: Gatekeeper may miss regressions if golden prompts are not representative; mitigation: expand suites and add sampled customer prompts for high-value customers.
Latency/Cost of evals: Running full evals increases cost; mitigation: use reduced-shot golden suites and early-fail heuristics to abort expensive runs when obvious signals appear.
Operational complexity: Added orchestration increases failure modes; mitigation: simple, well-instrumented state machine and human-in-the-loop emergency stop.
qa_plan: Unit tests for statistical decision logic with synthetic distributions.
Integration smoke that simulates a regression by injecting altered model outputs and asserts Gatekeeper triggers rollback.
Load test: ensure Gatekeeper can evaluate 20 candidate configs concurrently without exceeding evaluation worker quotas.
Manual QA: PM + Ops will run a dry-run against a staging cluster and review the Console visualization.
